summary: Lost hiker in the South Colony Basin (gateway to Crestone Peak, Crestone Needle and Humboldt Peak); Custer County Search and Rescue running an active search mission with mutual-aid teams staging at the lower parking lot; the area was closed to hikers and vehicles on Monday, November 23; the hiker's name, age, hometown, intended peak and date reported overdue were not released; search ongoing in cold, snowy conditions
notes: Freshness sweep 2026-11-23: Custer County Sheriff's Office Facebook post (posted Sun Nov 22, 9:48 p.m.) + SnowBrains article (published Nov 23, 06:09 MST), both parent-opened live. Date is the sheriff's announcement date; the exact date the hiker was reported overdue was not released, so the date is approximate. Search ongoing as of Nov 23 morning; follow up for resolution.
